newsitem.title: UK: European cotton sees light demand under market.
newsitem.headline: European cotton sees light demand under market.

text.p: The pattern of trading in raw cotton in West European markets has registered little change, traders said.

Some mills have continued to enquire for nearby shipment supplies, usually at prices below those acceptable to the trade. For its part, the trade believes that asking rates will strengthen between now and the autumn and there is no inclination, therefore, to offer significant price concessions.
Growths at the centre of attention have included Central Asian from stocks held in Baltic ports, together with various African descriptions.
